Problem 437. Temporal compatibility in a story set in 1550
Knowledge context.
Anachronism can be tested as a compatibility problem when the relevant date ranges are supplied.
Given facts.

For this problem, availability intervals are: Technology A: 1200–1600; Institution B: 1500–1900; Tool C: 1700–2000; Practice D: 1300–1450. A story is set in 1550 and mentions Technology A and Tool C together. Cross-domain check: a survey team starts work at 12:00 and works for 2 hour(s) without a break.
Rules.

An item is temporally compatible with a year only if the year lies inside its stated availability interval. An anachronism is an item placed outside its given interval. For the cross-domain check, finishing time = starting time + duration.
Task.
Which mentioned item, if any, is anachronistic in the story? Cross-domain check: at what time does the team finish?
Step-by-step solution.

1. Check 1550 against Technology A interval 1200–1600. 2. Check 1550 against Tool C interval 1700–2000. 3. Items outside their intervals: ['Tool C']. Cross-domain check: 12+2=14, so the team finishes at 14:00.
Answer.
Anachronistic: Tool C. Cross-domain answer: 14:00.
Knowledge takeaway.
